regions.name: Crossroads
regions.description: A weathered signpost leans where five roads meet. The wind carries the smell of rot.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water.

regions.name: Whispering Woods
regions.description: The trees lean close and the branches murmur your name.

regions.name: Bone Quarry
regions.description: Pale stone, pale dust, and pale shapes that move when you look away.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: A sunken altar, black water, and a bell that rings with no one to pull it.

regions.name: Obsidian Keep
regions.description: A fortress of black glass. Every window watches you.
